facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transformation's Baldna portal lists 141+ digital services (G2G 4, G2B 102, G2C 35).
Baldna, the national unified platform for government transactions, serves 48+ government institutions and signs users in with the national number or the Sudapass digital ID.
The Baldna portal shows 265,785+ completed transactions.
